plan:
Plan:
 1. sweep leftover WON-PROTO nodes; read won-e2e-simple-a product metafield (restore/delete at the end)
 2. create automatic node "WON-PROTO C3 size", config percent_all padded to 9000 B
 3. for each size (metafieldsSet on the node, then fresh carts until 2 consecutive reads match):
      9000 B, percent 11 → present
      10100 B, percent 13 → absent
      10000 B, percent 12 → record (boundary)
      10001 B, percent 14 → record (boundary)
    stored size is read back (discountNode.metafield.value) and logged per step
 4. node config → {prototype:{mode:product_metafield}}; metafieldsSet won-e2e-simple-a $app:won_discounts.product = {"percent":7}
    → cart discount ≈ 7 %
 5. finally: delete the node, delete/restore the product metafield, list WON-PROTO nodes (must be 0)
